
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/19971851" title="发布于 2026-05-04 16:15">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于AScript的python3脚本语言发布啦！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，支持扩展多种脚本语言，今天（2026年5月4日）正式发布了python3语言AScript.Lang.Python3的第1个版本0.0.1，快来试试吧！</p>
<h1>一、介绍</h1>
<p>支持python3基础语法、数据类型（int/float/bool/str/list/set/dict）、函数定义，以及列表、集合、字典操作。</p>
<h1>二、安装</h1>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> install-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">package AScript
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> install-package AScript.Lang.Python3</pre>
</div>
<h1>三、使用说明</h1>
<h2>1、注册语言</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> Script.Langs.Set(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, Python3Lang.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可全局设置为默认语言
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Script.Langs.Set("python3", Python3Lang.Instance, setDefault: true);</span></pre>
</div>
<h2>2、上下文中指定语言</h2>
<p>如果已全局设置默认语言则无需指定。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> [] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">def sum(a,b):
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return a+b
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum(10,20)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30L</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h2>3、使用@lang指定语言</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 默认csharp语言
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int mult(int a, int b) =&gt; a*b;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 嵌入python3语言
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@lang python3
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">def sum(a,b):
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return a+b
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int m = 10;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int n = 20;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mult(m, n) + sum(m, n);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">230</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h2>4、字符串插值</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name='tom'; 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">f'hello {name}, 5+8={5+8}'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> [] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello tom, 5+8=13</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h2>5、字符串索引和截取</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> [] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">e</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'hello'[1]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">e</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'hello'[-4]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'hello'[1:4]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'hello'[-4:-1]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h2>6、列表</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">list1 = [1,2,3]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">list2 = [3,4,5]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">list3=list1 + list2
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval&lt;List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1,2,3,3,4,5</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.Join(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, result));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2L</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">list3[1]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2L</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">list3[-5]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h2>7、集合</h2>
<p>集合元素是去重的。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span> = (HashSet&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>&gt;)script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">s = {1, 2, 2}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">s.add(3)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">s.add(2)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">s
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">9</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1,2,3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.Join(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h2>8、字典</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p = {'name': '张三', 'age': 18}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p['age']=20
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> [] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> dict = script.Eval&lt;Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, dict.Count);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, dict[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20L</span>, dict[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>]);</pre>
</div>
<h2>9、for遍历值</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">total = 0
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">for x in [1, 2, 3]:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    total += x
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">total
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };

</div>
<h2>10、for遍历值和索引</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result = ''
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">for i, x in enumerate([1, 2, 3]):
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    result += f'{i}:{x},'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">9</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">0:1,1:2,2:3,</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(code));</pre>
</div>
<h2>11、列表推导式</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[x * 2 for x in [1, 2, 3]]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = (List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)script.Eval(code);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, list.Count);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2L</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4L</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6L</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>]);</pre>
</div>
<h2>12、lambda</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">f = lambda a,b: a+b
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">f(10,20)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30L</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h2>13、类型注解</h2>
<p>指定变量类型及函数返回值类型。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@lang python3
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">def sum(a:int,b:int)-&gt;int:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return a+b
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">m:int=10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">n:int=20
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum(m,n)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30L</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h1>四、结束语</h1>
<p>python3语法是参考<a href="https://www.runoob.com/python3/python3-tutorial.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.runoob.com/python3/python3-tutorial.html</a>教程来实现的，欢迎大家一起交流学习！</p>
